what: One set of big text is repeated dup (default 2) times and flows endlessly to the left. The time for one set to pass is speed(15) × set width/screen width seconds (.25x below width 479 and .5x below 991, so it is faster on phones). Scrolling the page up reverses the flow in place, and scrolling down brings it back. While the panel passes from the bottom to the top of the screen, the whole band is tied to scroll and shifts once more from +10vw → −10vw (no curve)

options.scroll: Scroll-linked drift (vw), default 10. 0 means no drift
options.dup: Number of sets to join, default 2

use: Your big text here •
